name: davidgarciagordo-plugins
description: David García Gordo's Claude Code plugin catalog — one marketplace, pick what you install.

plugins.name: token-economy
plugins.description: Deterministic, tested context-pack script + a read-only lens agent scoped by tool list + a frugal output-style: measured 2.6×–7× fewer input tokens on multi-agent work at identical coverage. Composes with the caveman skill and uses claude-mem as its preferred memory backend.

plugins.name: design-review
plugins.description: 8-agent design pipeline with binary gates and a machine-checkable alive/templated/flat verdict backed by an enforcement hook. Ships 7 verified, commit-pinned playbooks that prevent the known failure modes of the third-party design skills it orchestrates.

plugins.name: forge-methodology
plugins.description: 9-step human↔AI methodology where completeness is mechanical: an enumerated reference with req-ids feeds an Acceptance Matrix, and a hook blocks `gh pr create` until every row carries evidence verified by someone other than the executor. 8 domain packs, 8 end-to-end examples.

plugins.name: working-methods
plugins.description: The Forge enforcement layer for Claude Code: /forge-run sequences 12 phases through machine-checked gates (forge.js, a zero-dependency state machine) with a fail-closed PR-gate hook. Also /grill (3-4 read-only adversarial lenses with a binary finding criterion) and /handoff (session relay on a durable scheduler).

plugins.name: automations
plugins.description: /optimize-my-setup: deterministic scan (scan.mjs) of all 8 .claude config surfaces + read-only agent fan-out + a mandatory multi-check — nothing is applied unless you tick it. Ships 4 fail-closed template hooks (guard-main, secrets-guard, commit-lint, ui-diff), 5 adversarial reviewers generated per-repo, and /release.
